title: Spezialität
import_notes: B1 Modelltest 4/16 (Nadia2/Language Tests, pages 45-46 printed = PDF pages 46-47 for situations, PDF page 47 for the ad block). The ad block page is an out-of-focus/blurry photograph of an actual printed 'telc Deutsch B1' exam booklet page embedded in the source PDF (visible footer code '1061-S10-010902') — re-rendering at up to 600 DPI did not recover additional detail since the blur is baked into the source photo itself, not a rendering-resolution issue. All 12 ad headlines/titles are legible; body-text fine print (exact addresses, phone numbers, precise opening hours) could not be fully verified pixel-by-pixel and is transcribed on a best-effort basis, with genuinely illegible fragments bracketed. This does not affect the exercise's core answer-matching logic, which was independently re-verified against the printed Lösungen key (11E 12F 13B 14K 15C 16J 17H 18X 19X 20L). Note situation 12 ('Museum am Montag') correctly maps to ad F rather than the more obvious-looking ad A ('Museum der Stadt Füssen') — a partial legible fragment on ad A's hours ('Mo. geschlossen') indicates it is closed Mondays, making it a deliberate distractor.
